name: Doomvisible
about: An offline archive of your incoming WhatsApp notifications. Viewing this archive never opens WhatsApp. It captures only content actually delivered in notifications: messages that produce no notification, or content Android hides, may be unavailable. The app has no internet permission. Manual JSON exports are unencrypted and may go to a cloud provider you choose.

steps.title: Allow restricted settings (Android 13+)
steps.text: Apps installed from an APK may need this once on Android 13+ before sensitive permissions work. Go to Settings > Apps > See all apps > doomvisible > More (3 dots) > Allow restricted settings. Only do this for apps you trust.

steps.title: Agree and turn on notification access
steps.text: Open doomvisible and tap I Agree & Continue, then turn on doomvisible in the notification access list that opens. The app reads only WhatsApp notifications and ignores everything else.

steps.title: Set battery to Unrestricted
steps.text: In Step 2 of the setup, open battery settings and choose Unrestricted. This may help capture keep running when the screen is off, but Android and phone makers can still pause it.
